source.CommitNote: Tag v2.0.0: the first release tag after the ToB audit (fixes merged in a135e48 'Audit fixes (#131)', 2024-04-17, fix-reviewed in the 2024-05-03 report; master then sat at f97118a until 2025). The repo has no tag between v1.0.0 (2023-02, pre-audit, the V2 ceremony version) and v2.0.0. Between f97118a and v2.0.0 the selected circuits only change cosmetically (signal tag, two dummy squaring constraints on public inputs in credentialAtomicQueryV3OffChain, StateTransition renamed StateTransitionV3); v2.0.0 also adds an unaudited credentialAtomicQueryV3Universal circuit, which is not selected.
